chinese: 这是汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生的《皇帝的新装》。
english: Here’s The Emperor’s New Clothes by Hans Christian Andersen.

chinese: 从前，一个皇帝非常喜欢衣服。
english: Once upon a time, an emperor liked clothes very much.
He wanted to buy some new clothes.

chinese: 两个兄弟来了，对他撒谎说，
english: Two brothers came and lied to him,
“We can make wonderful clothes!

chinese: 但只有聪明人才能看见它们！”
english: But only clever people can see them!”
They pretended to make the clothes.

chinese: 皇帝的大臣们看不见衣服，
english: The emperor’s officials couldn’t see the clothes,

chinese: 但他们却说：“多漂亮的衣服啊！”
english: but they said, “What lovely clothes!”
The emperor couldn’t see anything either,
but he said, “They’re beautiful!”
No one wanted to look silly.

chinese: 皇帝决定向所有人展示他的新衣服。
english: The emperor decided to show everyone his new clothes.

chinese: 街上的人们纷纷称赞它们。
english: People in the street praised them.
They were afraid to look silly too!
Suddenly, a boy shouted,
“Look! The emperor has no clothes on!”
Everyone looked at one another.
They started laughing.

chinese: 故事结束！你喜欢这个故事吗？
english: The end! Did you like the story?
Please tell me what you think!
